requests.title: Admit Emergency Patient to ICU
requests.description: Patient presenting with acute respiratory failure in emergency requires immediate ICU bed booking.
requests.sample_query: Please admit patient UHID-000008 into the ICU under Dr. Anbarasan for acute respiratory distress.

requests.title: Check Vacant Bed Availability in ICU
requests.description: Ward nurse needs to check whether there are any open ICU beds before moving a deteriorating patient.
requests.sample_query: Are there any available beds in the ICU right now?

requests.title: Submit Cashless Pre-Authorization Request
requests.description: New admission has Star Health insurance; pre-authorization packet needs submission.
requests.sample_query: How do I submit an insurance pre-auth request for Star Health policy POL-STAR-7821?

requests.title: Inquire About Insurance Claim Rejection Status
requests.description: Case manager checking why claim CLM-002 for Anitha Selvam was turned down.
requests.sample_query: Can you check the claim status and rejection reason for patient UHID-000004?

requests.title: Generate Four-Point Discharge Clearance
requests.description: Discharge desk coordinator verifying whether UHID-000007 has cleared pharmacy and billing.
requests.sample_query: Is patient UHID-000007 cleared for discharge across billing, pharmacy, and nursing?

requests.title: Order STAT Serum Electrolytes Panel
requests.description: Physician needs emergency STAT electrolytes panel ordered in LIS for ICU Bed 01.
requests.sample_query: Please order a STAT Serum Electrolytes panel for patient UHID-000001 in ICU.

requests.title: Report Ward Patient Fall Incident
requests.description: Staff nurse reporting an elderly patient slip in General Ward bathroom.
requests.sample_query: I need to file an incident report for an elderly patient fall in General Ward Bed 03.

requests.title: Retrieve Historical Case File from MRD
requests.description: Consultant requesting physical previous admission file of re-admitted cardiac patient.
requests.sample_query: How do I request a physical archived patient case file from Medical Records?

requests.title: Report Frozen EMR Terminal in ICU
requests.description: Workstation terminal frozen during vitals entry in ICU Bed 02.
requests.sample_query: The EMR workstation terminal at ICU Bed 02 is frozen and not accepting entries. Raise a ticket.

requests.title: Review Current Inpatient Bill Summary
requests.description: Billing executive reviewing unbilled consumables and insurance balance for patient in ICU.
requests.sample_query: What is the latest bill summary and patient payable balance for UHID-000001?

requests.title: Transfer Deteriorating Patient from Ward to ICU
requests.description: Patient in General Ward Bed 01 experiencing severe respiratory decline needs step-up to ICU.
requests.sample_query: Transfer patient UHID-000003 from General Ward Bed 01 to an available ICU bed immediately.

requests.title: Requisition Emergency Packed Red Blood Cells
requests.description: Polytrauma patient in emergency resuscitation bay requires 2 units of O-negative PRBC.
requests.sample_query: Request 2 units of Packed Red Blood Cells STAT from the Blood Bank for trauma patient UHID-000005.

requests.title: Check Unnotified Critical Lab Result Alert
requests.description: Quality auditor identifying unalerted critical potassium value for UHID-000001.
requests.sample_query: Show me any critical lab results that have not yet been alerted to the treating physician.

requests.title: Find Inpatient Admission Standard Operating Procedure
requests.description: Front office staff looking up protocol for admitting a patient without a government ID.
requests.sample_query: Where can I find the SOP for patient admission and what are the required documents?

requests.title: Query How to Allocate Bed in HIS
requests.description: New admission clerk requesting step-by-step guidance on bed allocation screen.
requests.sample_query: Explain how to allocate a bed in the HIS system.

requests.title: Resolve Patient Attender Billing Dispute
requests.description: Attender of UHID-000007 disputing Rs 13,000 extra consumable charge.
requests.sample_query: The attender of patient UHID-000007 is disputing the final bill. What is the escalation process?

requests.title: Verify PMJAY Ayushman Bharat Claim Protocol
requests.description: Billing clerk inquiring how to upload discharge summary into NHA portal.
requests.sample_query: How do we submit a PMJAY claim through the NHA portal at discharge?

requests.title: Check Mandatory Documents Needed for Patient Discharge
requests.description: Ward nurse verifying list of required papers before patient leaves ward.
requests.sample_query: What documents are required to complete a patient discharge according to SOP-DIS-001?

requests.title: Identify Responsible Team for TPA Denial Dispute
requests.description: Admission clerk asking which team to contact when cashless preauth is rejected.
requests.sample_query: Who do I contact when an insurance pre-authorization claim is rejected by the TPA?

requests.title: Clinical Escalation for Patient Refusing Life-Saving Treatment
requests.description: ICU patient demanding discharge against medical advice despite critical hypoxemia.
requests.sample_query: A severe respiratory distress patient in the ICU is refusing treatment and demanding immediate discharge. What should we do?
